maxwell.title: Band 8 Advanced Practice Physiotherapist
maxwell.bio: Louis Maxwell is an HCPC-registered physiotherapist (PH128483) working as a Band 8 Advanced Practice Physiotherapist, and an AI Engineer. He founded Living With Arthritis (registered charity 1218461) and clinically reviews every guide on the site. Content is educational and does not replace a personal assessment.
credentials: Founder of Living With Arthritis, registered charity 1218461
